v1.request: User requested reviewing demo confidence and other filtering for metric effects
v1.selection: No threshold or checkpoint selected; all fixed rules reported, reused DEV exploratory diagnostic
v1.confidence: Our uncalibrated max depth-plane softmax probability, NOT upstream learned depth_conf
v1.scope: Scene percentile across three synchronized native views among finite valid original predicted-mask depth points. Original demo normally ranks full-image predictions; scope differs explicitly.
v1.edge: Exact AST-extracted pinned upstream 3x3 range/depth>0.03; zero outside sparse predicted support retained as upstream input, thus silhouette neighbors can be rejected
v1.denominators: All144scenes432views per pipeline; complete original GT cloud/body recall and coverage, failures kept; scene mean F1, view mean overlap RMSE, equal 3seed mean
v1.limits: No semantic mask update, no source/data/model changes, no scale alignment, no sky model, no display alignment/limiting/fallback dummy point used
limitations: Only correlated synthetic opaque-skin DEV; reused DEV, no independent real-mm/unseen pose generalization
Filtering cannot recover missing depth or establish complete/watertight body
Overlap RMSE conditional on retained GT intersection; report original GT coverage jointly
Confidence ties retained via >= percentile; actual retention need not equal requested percentage
Black/white filters are appearance heuristics not semantic confidence
No numerical improvements attributed to learned VGGT confidence because it is absent in our custom head outputs
No threshold selection/promotion or significance claim; immutable original deadlines preserved
